title: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake and Dynasty Warriors: Origins join the PS Plus Game Catalog (Japan)
game: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake; Dynasty Warriors: Origins
status: rendered v3, awaiting Arabic passes, director QA and Mohammad preview

claims.text: Dragon Quest III (Japanese title そして伝説へ..., the HD-2D Remake) is added to the PS Plus Game Catalog in November 2026
Dynasty Warriors: Origins (真・三國無双 ORIGINS) is added to the Game Catalog in December 2026
claims.source: primary: 12月にはコーエーテクモゲームスの
Denfami relay only; NOT in the primary; not used in the Reel

claims.text: Extra and Premium subscribers, PS4 and PS5
claims.source: not stated in the primary; left out

angle.hook: a big JRPG remake lands on PS Plus this month (Japan)
angle.why_now: announced today in the Portal post
angle.players_here: the worldwide list follows; no regional date yet

decisions: Dates from the primary only: 11月 and 12月, no day. The 17 November date from the Denfami relay is not used.
Editor decision (a), 9 Nov: build on the primary's wording; tiers and platforms out of line 2.
Japanese title そして伝説へ... = Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake (Square Enix's Japanese title for the remake).
Names per names-ar.md: سكوير (Square Enix) and كوي تكمو (Koei Tecmo) at first mention; مدونة بلايستيشن (PlayStation Blog).
whatsnew: Primary (JP): catalog additions in 11月 (Dragon Quest III) and 12月 (Dynasty Warriors: Origins); the same post's hardware story (Portal, 10 Dec, JPY 39,980) ran as the Portal Player Reel at 07:45 Dubai.

versions.change: built on the primary's wording, editor decision (a)
